title: Fuel Reimbursement Form
subtitle: Business Fuel Reimbursement: reconciles purchases, receipts, and approval.
description: Fuel Reimbursement Form covers authorized trip, vehicle, fuel purchase, receipt, mileage, allocation, and payment request. The transport expense coordinator records Business Fuel Reimbursement business purpose, purchases, receipts, and approval. Fuel Reimbursement Form keeps Business Fuel Reimbursement exceptions visible until the transport expense coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Fuel Reimbursement Form at business trip route, fueling location, assigned vehicle, and accounting record. Document authorized trip, vehicle, fuel purchase, receipt, mileage, allocation, and payment request identity before Business Fuel Reimbursement begins. Compare authorized trip, vehicle, fuel purchase, receipt, mileage, allocation, and payment request findings with stated Business Fuel Reimbursement criteria; route unresolved Business Fuel Reimbursement issues to authorized expense reviewer.

sections.title: Expense context and business record
sections.guidance: For Business Fuel Reimbursement, identify responsible parties, business trip route, fueling location, assigned vehicle, and accounting record, and the linked authorized trip, vehicle, fuel purchase, receipt, mileage, allocation, and payment request source.

fields.label: Vehicle, unit, plate, and fuel card
Trip, route, business purpose, receipt, and transaction

sections.title: Claim lines and substantiation checks
sections.guidance: Capture Business Fuel Reimbursement facts for authorized trip, vehicle, fuel purchase, receipt, mileage, allocation, and payment request; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Business Fuel Reimbursement substantiation checks
items: Purchase date, location, product, quantity, and amount
Allocation, approval, posting, and payment status

sections.title: Claim exception and reimbursement decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Business Fuel Reimbursement conditions; have transport expense coordinator assign the next Business Fuel Reimbursement owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Unsupported items, adjustments, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Business Fuel Reimbursement when purchase evidence, business purpose, vehicle match, amount support, or independent approval remains unresolved. Retain the available Business Fuel Reimbursement proof and route unresolved authorized trip, vehicle, fuel purchase, receipt, mileage, allocation, and payment request scope to transport expense coordinator.
